parameters.description:
`chime-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `chime` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Amazon Chime URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters.
parameters.plus_base_url: ${ customer_secrets._CHIME_BASE ?? https://hooks.chime.aws }/incomingwebhooks/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.webhook_id_secret }} }?token=${ customer_secrets.{{ params.token_secret }} }
parameters.summary: Relay a message to your own Amazon Chime room by posting a native Chime payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's chime token

webhook_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's chime webhook id
